annotations.title: Score exit timing before a slash

description: Subtract the unbonding time and the withdrawal delay from the soonest caller-supplied slash horizon. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/restaking-risk/exit-window Keywords: before you restake or reuse collateral, unbonding hours, withdrawal delay hours, events, exit feasibility score, exit_feasibility_score, time buffer hours, time_buffer_hours, Score exit timing before a slash, exit window.

hours_until_slash.description: hours until slash, integer, from any to 8760. Required.

unbonding_hours.description: unbonding hours, integer, from 0 to 8760. Required.

withdrawal_delay_hours.description: unbonding hours, integer, from 0 to 8760. Required.
